card.name: Linking words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words in the middle of dose-preparation and dose-adjustment instructions, such as "for" after a vial count, "administered" after a volume, and "in" after risks. It also fires on units and brackets inside dose rates.

modes.label: Vial and volume instructions
